name: importance
description:
Computes a 4-channel importance score for a memory entity: novelty (how surprising), arousal (emotional intensity), reward (past retrieval success), attention (recency/frequency).

CALL WHEN: Prioritizing which memories to surface, deciding whether to consolidate or prune, or ranking retrieval results by relevance.
RETURNS: Per-channel scores (0-1) and a weighted composite score.
Cost: ~5ms.
